crossRefs.note: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell…

parallels.note: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Zadok
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

translations.web: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.
translations.bsb: So Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, “This is what Ahithophel has advised Absalom and the elders of Israel, and this is what I have advised.
translations.kjv: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.
translations.asv: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.
